summary:
# NOTES: *English Ways and By-Ways* (1920), Letters of John & Ruth Dobson to Leighton Parks

Single book. Epistolary. Narrator alternates: John (Rev. John Dobson) or Ruth (wife). Letters to Leighton Parks (temporarily blind; Miss Fuller reads his letters to him; he is in California; Parks has a Rectory). Preface by L.P., Point-au-Pic, Quebec, Aug 1920. Aim: humor, ease tension, "The test of friendship is sympathetic banter." Dedicated to E.S.P. Epigraph Burns: "For me, an aim I never fash--I rhyme for fun." Pub. Scribner's 1920; some pieces from *Atlantic Monthly*.

**Cast:** John Dobson (parson; ancestry Ulster and Wales; pipe; blunt, jokey, "unconventional"; "cross" when tired). Ruth Dobson (Boston; English stock, Norfolk/Devon; thrifty; sensible; sharp humor). Sister Maud Simpson (Yorkshire; husband Sir Thomas, MP; children Edward, nurse Miles, Dick, William the boy). Rex (Irish setter, Mr. Dennis's gift). Dr. Webster. Aunt Susan B. Melchor. Mabel Wheelock (Pelham). Hathaway (carpenter). Weeks & Burke (lawyers). Patrick Quinn ("Professor," driving teacher). James Hawkins (preacher, "brain of a flea"). Frontenac car.

## I. The Legacy (Ruth)
Good Friday, hot. Ruth at study window with Rex; John waved, called "Hello, Rex!"; dog jumped two flights, died on steps. John: "I wish it were I." Tea; pipe ("given it up for Lent" / "not for to-day"). Hathaway made box. Burial at Mabel Wheelock's, Pelham; hotel taxi $7. New Easter hat: store woman took price of taxi off bill ("when that hat is seen on you there will be a run on them"). Dr. Webster: "You can't afford to keep on." Gushy woman: "salt in lumps." John slept Easter night. Letter from Weeks & Burke: Aunt Susan dead. John: "Well, I'll be jiggered!" Aunt Susan went to California ~20 yrs ago; had thought John's father attracted to her; met old beau in CA; land speculation; left money to son of man she loved. John: "Lakewood be blowed!" Europe. "lay down for a sunny day."

## II. School of Instruction (John)
Motor trip, Ruth's idea; cheap car, no chauffeur. John knows less of motors than of camels. Lessons with Prof. Patrick Quinn (profanity; "damn awkward"). Jerome Avenue trolley posts "move like Birnam wood." Cut in, hub nicked other car's tire. Concourse hill, bridge, buttress, railing; Quinn grabbed wheel; prayer "O my G--d... Vanderbilt Cup race." Quinn's driving "Fabian"; called drivers "brother." John decided not to return; no diploma.

## III. "Fool Proof" (John)
Two-cylinder rejected (salesman: silent cars cause accidents, "ten-thousand-dollar suit"). Ruth stalled demo. Frontenac runabout; folding seat for chauffeur; salesman: "FOOL PROOF"; self-starter. Deposit paid. Three laps round park; delivered to dock.

## IV. "Der Kaiser Wilhelm der Zweite" (John)
Ship. Poker ("twenty-five cents a point"); "De trouble mit men who hafe lifed all der lives in a village." Sunday band "Ein Feste Burg." John preached in Lounge. Jewish man: "If Christians began by treating us as if we were human..." Prayed for Kaiser (first time). German-Americans. Plymouth: mines fired from shore; officer: "childish way... their merchant marine." Der Tag; Spectator; "retired admirals."

## V. The Car Arrives (John)
Ruth to sister in Yorkshire by train. *Georgic* at Tilbury; car "at risk of owner." Third officer: NY port vs Venice; neatness; "vacuum cleaners." Casual laborer: "Shall I wind her up, Guv'ner?" "You 'ave fergot the 'andle." Self-starter; shilling; "Well, I'm damned!" Chauffeur: English cars durable; "changes... not always improvements." Garage near Leicester Square.

## VI. The Great North Road (John)
Chauffeur left John at Hatfield. Inn "Purple Cow," near GN Railway. Ostler: coaching days, "Ichabod"; refused to wash car. Dinner: soup, fish, chicken, huge tart. Hatfield House; Godkin; A.V.G. Allen: "Salisbury was the typical Englishman." Pendulum-of-metals idea. Took wrong road, 20+ miles too far east near Cambridge. Laborer: retrace; John went to Royston. Scott, Dickens, Jeanie Deans, Squeers, Pickwick, Fielding.

## VII. The England of Fielding (John)
Inn "Dappled Hart." Lamb, peas, cherry tart. Ban on smoking; bar. Drummer; village doctor ("medical man"); "convenience" debate; Tom Jones; Squire Westons; Dogberry; landlord's "midden."

## VIII. The End of the North Road (John)
Head-on near-collision with touring car (driver Henry; wife). John on wrong side. Henry: "Drunk?" "are you going to turn out, or are you looking for trouble?" Wife: "it is an American, and he is on the wrong side." Mrs. Raddles-style scolding; "claws." Skipped Grantham, went to Peterborough. Speed: 30 to average 20. Archway; mud-guard crumpled. Peterborough cathedral. Newark, Trent, Hotspur's "monstrous cantle." Donchester. Fountains Abbey. Arrived "Beeches."

## IX. An English Interior (Ruth)
John "busy" with car; William (boy ~14): "Spanner, sir, yes, sir." Servants trim; servant problem; Maud: "precedent," "give warning." Ruth: Mary Maloney, Mrs. McCarthy, Charles Street, Boston; Katie Hogan. Maud: "talking just like Thomas." Under-housemaid's "correct insolence."

## X. Husband and Wife (Ruth)
Miles = Nanny. Ruth vs. trained nurses, Irish accent, "enjoy ill health," Christian Science. Edward: "my business is rather urgent." Maud: Nanny = last feudal retainer; "noble lord": "You should see my Nanny!" Alice Burns, Elsie Graham, Mrs. Sherburne. Englishwomen: companionship with husbands. Dinner announced to host. Sir Thomas: aisle seat/flintlock explanation; host takes lady in; "end-seat hog." Roosevelt "thank God for it."

## XI. The Fourth Speed (John)
Sir Thomas: "tired of life or of my wife." Hill near Sawley (Ripon). John pulled fourth-speed lever, not emergency brake. Picnic pony-cart; boy "Oh, I say!" Ruth: "Don't you think, dear, that was a little fast?" Laborer: "there be two of 'em." Young Englishman tip: gear down, switch off current, clutch, engine as brake; Stelvio.

## XII. "Jael the Wife of Heber the Kenite" (Ruth)
John grumpy; Ruth writes Sunday. Preacher: Jael "a type of the Blessed Virgin." John walked out: "Not yet" sick. Diatribe ("stench," "ointment"). Kingsley "Sands o' Dee." Evensong: "I know where thou dwellest"; anthem "Love Divine."

## XIII. "As It Was in the Beginning" (Ruth)
Garden stranger: "I saw you... you left hurriedly." John: Jael not proper. Garage water. "Really, I should never have suspected it!" Ruth: Norfolk/Devon vs. John's Ulster/Wales; "freaks." Stranger: sermons = nap; Lloyd George, Asquith; son-in-law Nonconformist; Established Church "bulwark"; "As it was in the beginning" = Canute.

## XIV. Rural England (John)
Barchester → Gloucester road; "finest road." Hounds; huntsman "James the Huntsman." "Chevalier" groom; horse brother of Derby winner. Sheep, shepherd, dog. Ruth: "gentry" bobbing. Crugan story: Tom Crugan (Hoboken, carriage, mail-wagon, "Why the hell can't you keep your belly out of my brake?").

## XV. Education (John)
Gloucester (Saxon-Norman-Gothic). Wells west front. Chambered Nautilus. Bicycling parson & daughter. Bath, Beau Brummell, Thackeray. Winchester; St Cross pilgrims' bread & ale. House master: Caesar, Virgil, Latin prose; "boys go to school too late"; father decides in England. Prof. Corson: "Any except 'Education'!"

## XVI. A By-Election (John)
Salisbury: "built, not grown"; Pecksniff. Gentleman: avoid highway. Stonehenge. Divises by-election: Labor member Bowles vs Conservative ("free rum"). Parson, daughter, pony with blue ribbons; "The King and the Church." Young man rescued Ruth to mother's sitting-room. "Ridden on a rail." Vested interests.

## XVII. Sheep-Dogs (John)
Ross; Wye valley; Tintern; Wordsworth. Parked; cart shaft pierced radiator ("like 'avin' your horse took with the gripes"). Cyclist plugged it. Garage: wrong radiator. Sheep-dog trial; whistles; dog "Well done, good and faithful servant."

## XVIII. Brigands and Bootblacks (John)
New radiator C.O.D. from London. Visit to Captain Burchell (retired naval; son Roy in New Rochelle). Mrs. Freeman Allen joke (Amherst/Palmer). Mrs. Burchell: fear of sea, brigands in *Times*; "dissenters from the church of Christ"; "Fifteenth Avenue Church." Daughter: Bessie Salter; boots blacked by "nigger" in cellar. Ruth laughs; "cherry tart and custard."

## XIX. The Piston-Rod (John)
Valley of Wye/Shropshire. Ruth's rhapsody on exiles. Broken glass; tires "guaranteed five thousand miles." Noise; valves Nos. 2 and 4. "Broken piston-rod." Urchin: "Your tire's flat!" Nail. Rim change 3 min + 27. John sarcastic; Ruth in tears; "honey."

## XX. Falstaff (John)
Shrewsbury: wet tram rails, front wheels slid to sidewalk. Garage at "Raven." Battlefield; Hotspur, Hal, Falstaff. Mr. Rhodes historian: Falstaff "fought a long hour by Shrewsbury clock." Letters changed plans; left car.

## XXI. The Black Country (John)
Archdeacon Williams (Saltbridge; books; no smoking). Plain brick vicarage; smoke-blackened. Children: Rose (~12), Dick. Mrs. Williams "intellectual companion"; "men asphyxiated by dull wives." Sunday-school treat; mill-worker 50: "first time talked with a gentleman"; "vicar... is a _man_." Cotton famine; John Bright. Rose: "Not on your life"; fly (horse-cab) 10 shillings; "bug and fly"; "bounders."

## XXII. An "Average" Sunday (John)
Early service 8; mission chapel sermon. Twelve-mile drive; sermon on education, Parable of Sower. Archdeacon: teachers underpaid → effeminacy. Evening sermon; "noblest parish church in England" (Ruskin). Securalists. "Average day." Vicar's "vested interest" ideas. Train: first-class via guard.

## XXIII. Dowager and Cowboy (Ruth)
John to Saltbridge. Ruth to Deepford: Admiral Sir George Shelburne; Gertrude; "lady's walk"; secretary with despatch-box; blue-eyed Guy (naval, Gib). Lady Agatha Bumstead (dowager): Tweed, Erie, Cheyenne, "He spat!", "Always a pleasure to help a lady!" Beresford.

## XXIV. "By Pureness, by Kindness, by Love Unfeigned" (John)
Telegram; Sanfords' invite. Stratford (unvisited), Banbury, Oxford, Ipswich (Pickwick). Sanfords at Sharrow; non-juror ancestor's bed; Ceylon tea. Sunday: porridge; church; Mr. Sanford reads lesson; vicar's tithe/cow Scroston; oak trees; heifer "saft." Evening servants' prayers; footman tenor; butler. Mr. Sanford's apology. "Peccavi."

## XXV. The County Families (Ruth)
Maypole inn (Barnaby Rudge). Drive through London East End; Whitechapel, Cannon St, St Paul's, Holborn, Leicester Sq. Garvin's Private Hotel (Slocums). Telegram in porters' rack. Dinner; Benson's novel. Old squire: hat from Bonwit Teller's; "Matilda"; bathrooms, Chicago housemaid; roses as John's sin-offering.

## XXVI. The Boat-Race (John)
London; Ingrams from Boston. Mortlake; punts; Cambridge won. Lad: "Which won?" John: "Harvard." Indignant man. Siegels at Maidenhead ("Chilled Steel"). Harvard overtrained.

## XXVII. The Custom-House (John)
Siegel: grandfather 1848 with Schurz. Frankfort trunks; porter "field-marshal"; locksmith; Munich. Charlie Wilson. Ruth: "hardness" in such men.

## XXVIII. The "Rob" Room (Ruth)
Windsor, "Purple Sow" (White Heifer). St George's; Athanasian Creed, John refused to stand. "Rob" room joke; "I thank God I am an American." Lady Groves near Reading; "Bird" room. Buckthornes; Miss Buckthorne: "How do you manage... precedence?" John's butler-dinner tall tale.

## XXIX. Vested Interests (John)
Sir William Groves on Anglican Church in States. Rector's glebe; Mr. Buckthorne: parson's farmer's daughter, bar, partridges "sitting."

## XXX. "The Auld Un'" (John)
Sir William's shoot; keeper Jenkins; ferrets; John shot the "Auld Un'." Boy Jock. Then shot a pheasant out of season; cover-up. Winkle joke.

## XXXI. Church and State (John)
Malvern; Abbey; girls' hair; curate's sermon; no Sunday papers. Vicar's prayers for Cause Célèbre judges. Smoking-room men. Ladies: lynching; Lloyd George hanged; John Burns.

## XXXII. The Chaplain to the Queen (John)
Chester; Betts-y-Coed "Waterloo"; John as porter, beautiful voice. Celt vs Saxon. Rev. Henry Waitland (Dean Stanley look). Queen's chaplain: Ponsonby's wrong collect; Queen's reply.

## XXXIII. The Retired Colonel (John)
Llandudno sands; children; Ruth "delphinium." Philistines. War foreboding; Spectator; German hatred. Retired colonel: "My G--d!" Weir Mitchell mosquito patient.

## XXXIV. A Problem in Casuistry (John)
Cork squalor. Killarney: "John, have you got your shirt on?" Duke laughed. Carter: "this road's that narrer, it ain't properly got two sides." Policeman will "represent him to himself." Giant: "lying from a kind heart," Australia, "Home Rule." Blarney Castle; Chesterfield coal-mine joke.

## XXXV. A Day of Trouble and Distress (John)
Self-starter failing; cul-de-sac; Ruth dragged dog by tail; John "Damnation." Level crossing woman: "Dublin express"; self-starter caught; slid off track. Lost way; Ross; Ruth wept. Dublin: professor Hodges (wife Anne); batteries charged. Dublin Castle. Holyhead; Waterloo.

## XXXVI. "One Every Minute" (John)
Barchester; coaching inn. Frontenac Co. reply: new generator ~$300. Maud's telegram; Ruth stayed. Banbury, Oxford, London. Frontenac manager: "born every minute." Music hall: Chevallier; Sarah Bernhardt. Holland Hotel; page "Mr. Dobson, if you please." Ruth telegram: Kensington. Fault: headlights left on three weeks (covered in Ireland). Manager: "One Every Minute."

## XXXVII. Anglia or Frontenac? (John)
Car boxed at Tilbury; returning on *Adriatic*. Ruth's pregnancy confirmed by doctor ("looked like papa"). No motoring. Ruth: boy named John. Apologia: English public-school education, merged-family individualism. "America was in the loins of England."
